10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:8f1e1745-4d3d-4c.title: Risk Analyst - AI Trainer - Freelance - 8-20hrs/week - Remote
10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:8f1e1745-4d3d-4c.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced risk analyst or risk management professional who instinctively identifies reasoning gaps and understands the real-world complexities of risk in business and finance? Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main role or consulting projects? Join us in shaping how AI understands and applies risk analysis at scale. About the Role 10x.team connects expert freelancers with leading AI labs building next-generation models. We are seeking experienced risk analysts and risk management professionals based in the EU or UK to deepen the accuracy, insight, and real-world relevance of AI-powered risk assessment and mitigation systems. What You Will Do - Review and refine AI-generated outputs on topics such as risk identification, evaluation, mitigation strategies, compliance, operational and financial risk management - Evaluate AI responses for practical application, business realism, and sound risk logic - Draft realistic business risk scenarios and case studies informed by your direct experience - Create variations of scenarios from diverse perspectives (e.g. risk manager, compliance officer, executive, board member) - Identify gaps, oversimplifications, or flawed assumptions in AI-generated risk analysis In simple terms: You will assess and improve AI-generated risk management content, ensuring it reflects rigorous logic, authentic expertise, and practical strategies. Instead of traditional advisory work, you’ll use your experience to help AI systems truly understand and reason about modern risk challenges at scale. Who You Are - An experienced/senior-level risk analyst, risk manager, or similar practitioner - Based in and eligible to work in the EU or UK - Several years of hands-on experience in risk analysis, risk assessment, compliance, operational or financial risk management - Strong ability to spot weak logic, theoretical gaps, or impractical assumptions in risk reasoning - Comfortable working independently and providing clear, structured feedback - Available for 8–20 hours per week, with immediate or near-term availability Why Join? - Flexible, fully remote work that fits your schedule - Apply your risk management expertise in a cutting-edge AI environment - Directly contribute to shaping the next generation of AI systems - Free access to our in-house AI Academy to advance your AI skillset - Clear onboarding, structured projects, and potential for ongoing collaboration How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Join us to help shape the risk intelligence of the world’s most advanced AI models! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable

In this role, you’ll support daily operations, deliver a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, and help drive sales by sharing product knowledge. Our partner is looking for a Director, Client Success based in United States. This senior leadership role is responsible for driving client growth, retention, and long-term value across a portfolio of strategic accounts. You will lead a team of Client Success professionals focused on strengthening post-sales relationships and increasing product adoption. The role combines people leadership, commercial strategy, client engagement, and operational execution in a large-scale IT services environment. You will own regional revenue and gross profit objectives through renewals, upselling, and cross-selling of technology and service offerings. Success requires the ability to translate complex client needs and business data into actionable strategies and measurable outcomes. You will also influence regional and global Client Success practices while partnering closely with sales, service delivery, consulting, and other stakeholders. This is an opportunity to shape client strategy, develop high-performing teams, and contribute directly to sustainable business growth. Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic clients, understanding their business priorities and positioning relevant technology, managed services, support, consulting, and technical solutions. oriongroup-oriongroup:greenhouse:4708670.title: Vice President of Business Development, Helios HVACR Services
oriongroup-oriongroup:greenhouse:4708670.description: Vice President, Business Development Reports to: President, Helios HVACR Services About Helios HVACR Services Helios HVACR Services is a national commercial HVACR services platform serving multi-site and national account customers across the United States. The Helios operating model is different from a traditional branch-based mechanical contractor. Our customers rely on us to deliver consistent service across a national footprint through local field teams. Our technicians work across a broad range of equipment and environments while navigating different customer requirements, service-level agreements, not-to-exceed limits, IVR systems, documentation requirements, and operating protocols. Executing that model consistently at scale requires a different level of commercial discipline. Helios has built a strong foundation for its next phase of growth. The opportunity now is to continue expanding our national footprint, increase productive field capacity, strengthen density in priority markets, and win the right customers while maintaining strong margin discipline and an exceptional customer experience. Helios operates as part of Orion Group, a national network of commercial and industrial service businesses focused on operational excellence, leadership development, and disciplined growth. Position Overview The Vice President of Business Development & Growth is the senior commercial growth leader for Helios HVACR Services. This is a hands-on player-coach role responsible for personally creating and closing meaningful HVACR opportunities while building and leading a small, high-performing business development team. This leader will drive profitable growth by opening new customer relationships, expanding strategic accounts, developing new channels, and ensuring Helios wins the right revenue in the right markets. This is not a traditional sales management role. Success requires a leader who enjoys being in the market, building executive relationships, creating opportunities before formal RFPs exist, negotiating complex service agreements, and developing a repeatable growth engine. Key Responsibilities Personally Drive Profitable HVACR Growth · Personally originate, develop, negotiate, and close meaningful national and multi-site HVACR opportunities. · Build executive relationships with facilities, operations, procurement, and other customer decision makers. · Create opportunities through proactive prospecting, relationship development, and market intelligence. · Build a qualified pipeline across service, maintenance, and project opportunities. · Ensure growth meets Helios margin, operational, and serviceability requirements. Build Density in Priority Markets · Partner with Operations and Finance to identify priority markets where growth creates the greatest strategic value. · Focus commercial efforts on opportunities that improve customer density, technician utilization, and operating leverage. · Evaluate opportunities based on quality of revenue, not simply contract value. · Challenge opportunities that create unnecessary complexity or cannot be executed profitably. Expand Existing Customer Relationships · Partner with Client Management to identify and pursue whitespace opportunities within existing national accounts. · Expand relationships across geographies, locations, and service offerings. · Convert strong operational performance into additional customer growth. Build and Lead a High-Performing Business Development Team · Recruit, develop, and lead a small team of business development professionals. · Establish clear goals, KPIs, pipeline expectations, and accountability. · Personally coach team members while remaining actively involved in strategic pursuits. · Build a culture focused on hunting, urgency, accountability, and execution. strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:77996.title: Warehouse & Logistics Lead
strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:77996.description: Job Opportunity: Warehouse and Logistics Lead with Ditsch USA in Cincinnati, OH Are you a hands-on warehouse professional who enjoys leading, by example, coaching others, and keeping operations moving? Ditsch USA is hiring a Warehouse & Logistics Lead in Cincinnati, Ohio to help guide daily warehouse activities, support the team, maintain inventory accuracy, and ensure products are received, stored, and shipped safely and efficiently. Starting Pay: $21.44 - $23.48 per hour. Schedule: 1st Shift | 7:00 AM - 3:00 PM Additional Hours: Weekends and additional hours may be required based on business needs. Why Join Ditsch USA? Competitive starting pay: $21.44 - $23.48/hour Medical, dental, and vision insurance 401(k) with company match Paid Time Off (PTO), paid holidays, and life insurance Training, advancement opportunities, and a team-oriented culture About the Role What You’ll Do: Lead daily warehouse activities including shipping, receiving, inventory, staging, and logistics support. Use and support WMS/ERP systems to maintain accurate shipping, receiving, inventory, and transaction records. Assign daily tasks, coordinate dock activity, and help prioritize workflow across warehouse areas. Support inventory accuracy through cycle counts, audits, FIFO rotation, labeling, and reconciliation. Coordinate with production, transportation, and warehouse leadership to keep materials moving efficiently. Inspect inbound and outbound shipments for accuracy, quality, and compliance. Serve as a PIT/forklift trainer and coach team members on safety, best practices, and operational efficiency. Support onboarding, cross-training, food safety standards, and daily communication with warehouse employees. What You Bring What We’re Looking For: High School Diploma or GED required. Warehouse, logistics, inventory, shipping, and receiving experience required. Experience using WMS or ERP systems required; Sage experience strongly preferred. Forklift/PIT operating experience required; lead, trainer, or coordinator experience preferred. Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and multitasking skills. Knowledge of GMP, warehouse safety, and food manufacturing practices preferred. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing business needs. Able to meet the physical demands of a warehouse environment, including lifting up to 50 pounds, standing for extended periods, working in varied temperatures, and safely operating around equipment. Leadership Style: Leads by example and earns respect through action. Holds themselves and others accountable. Coaches, trains, and supports team members with a positive, adaptable approach. Builds strong working relationships while driving safety, accuracy, and results. Ready to Lead and Grow? If you're looking for an opportunity to combine warehouse expertise, logistics coordination, inventory management, and hands-on leadership in a growing food manufacturing environment, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online today! Se habla español – Spanish-speaking candidates are welcome to apply.
